admissibility_rule: A direct-package contract must specify U.S. federal enactment, a deadline before fiscal stress is realized, and a recurring budget effect large enough to map to the prudent-course adjustment.

best_live_fiscal_outcome_market.title: Will U.S. federal deficit-to-GDP for FY2026 be below 5%?
best_live_fiscal_outcome_market.why_not_direct: One-year outcome or adjacent fiscal contract; it does not resolve enactment of the recurring prudent-course package.

critical_caveats: Kalshi volume_fp is contract volume, not USD; the normalized data preserves that unit.
Polymarket volume is USD-denominated; executable bid/ask comes from the public CLOB book when available.
Adjacent outcome markets do not identify passage probability and receive zero direct score weight.
interpretation: The API and order-book subsystem is complete. Market candidates are corroborating features; when no contract directly maps to the prudent package, the scored passage probability comes from the separately disclosed empirical enactment model rather than remaining missing.
